description: Step 1 of 2 for sending an inquiry to the responsible i22 team on behalf of the person you are helping. Sends nothing: returns a summary and a confirmation token. Show the person the summary, and call i22_ai_inquiry_send only after they confirm it. All fields come from the person; never invent them.

email.description: E-mail address of the person; the team replies to it. No confirmation mail is sent to it.

message.description: The inquiry in the person's own words.

name.description: Full name of the person sending the inquiry.

next_step.description: Desired next step: callback (phone call; put a phone number in the message), meeting or documents (send documents).

role.description: Role or job title of the person at the company.

topic.description: Slug of the service the inquiry is about, from i22_ai_services_list (e.g. agentic-transformation), or "unclear" when no service fits.

name: i22_ai_inquiry_preview
title: Prepare an inquiry to i22
